content.name: Amira Haddad
content.title: Graduate Mechanical Engineer
content.summary: Graduate mechanical engineer with a First-class MEng from the University of Nottingham and a summer placement in pump design. Now working on precision machined assemblies for rail and aerospace customers, enrolled on the IMechE's Monitored Professional Development Scheme towards CEng.

experience.title: Summer Engineering Placement
bullets: Modelled impeller and volute variants in SolidWorks and compared head-flow curves from test rig data.
Wrote a Python script to clean and plot test rig data, cutting report preparation from a day to about two hours.
Presented placement findings to the engineering manager, who used them to shortlist two impeller designs for prototyping.

experience.title: Graduate Mechanical Engineer
bullets: Design and detail jigs, fixtures and machined assemblies for rail and aerospace customers using SolidWorks and BS 8888 drawing standards.
Ran hand calculations and FEA checks on a lifting fixture, which passed its proof load test first time.
Supported a root-cause investigation into a recurring bore tolerance issue, contributing to a 12% drop in scrap on that part family.
Rotate through design, quality and production teams as part of the two-year graduate scheme.

education.details: IMechE-accredited; group project on a low-cost prosthetic knee

achievements.title: Formula Student
achievements.detail: Suspension team lead for the university's Formula Student car in 2023.

achievements.title: Dean's prize
achievements.detail: Awarded for the highest-scoring MEng individual project in the cohort.
